name: Testfully Developer Edition
free_limit: One offline workspace and one cloud workspace; up to 5 users per workspace; unlimited collection runner; Testfully CLI; 2,000 API-monitoring credits per month at 30-minute monitoring intervals.
watch_out: Free tier has workspace and user limits; monitoring history is 2 days. Team/Enterprise features, faster monitoring intervals and additional monitoring credits require paid plans. Credit-card requirement for the free Developer Edition is not explicitly confirmed on the reviewed pricing page.
